external_research_checked.finding: Target config independently confirms hidden_size=1024, vocab_size=248320, 24 text layers, tied embeddings, bfloat16 model dtype and full_attention_interval=4 with full-attention layers 3/7/11/15/19/23.

external_research_checked.source: Yin & Steinhardt, ICML 2025, Which Attention Heads Matter for In-Context Learning?
external_research_checked.finding: Across tested models, few-shot ICL depends primarily on function-vector heads, with induction and FV mechanisms related.
external_research_checked.implication: Do not turn the source report's induction-head explanation for B into a required mechanism. Treat it as a hypothesis; accept behavior/state invariants and establish learned mechanism by ablation/lesion/rescue.

external_research_checked.source: Zhao et al., ICLR 2025, Beyond Single Concept Vector
external_research_checked.finding: Single concept vectors can be unstable; concept-subspace modeling is more robust.
external_research_checked.implication: Supports subspace-aware measurement directionally, but exact rank 3 remains target-checkpoint-specific evidence.

external_research_checked.source: Khayatan et al., ICCV 2025, Analyzing Finetuning Representation Shift
external_research_checked.finding: Fine-tuning can shift internal concept representations.
external_research_checked.implication: Add checkpoint-by-checkpoint ABI/representation drift audits; pre-fine-tune semantic subspaces, whitening statistics and steering geometry cannot be assumed invariant.

new_research_deductions.rule: At baseline and each selected checkpoint re-measure semantic decodability/rank, centering/whitening statistics, atom response/crosstalk, codec cycle error, write margin/damage and cross-template transfer; bind results to checkpoint hash + ABI manifest hash.
new_research_deductions.reason: The training objective changes hidden representations. A base-model ABI measurement cannot silently certify a tuned checkpoint.

new_research_deductions.rule: Track unembedding/symbol-basis stability separately from hidden-state mean/whitening/subspace stability.
new_research_deductions.reason: The target config ties word embeddings; if embeddings/unembedding are trained, atom rows can drift. Even if they are frozen, hidden-state distributions can drift.

new_research_deductions.rule: Measure the end-to-end precision boundary explicitly: float64 encode/HRR/decode outside the model, declared cast/injection into model dtype at the ABI boundary, then downstream symbol/semantic damage.
new_research_deductions.reason: A float64 external codec cycle guarantee does not by itself prove a bfloat16 injection/reentry path is lossless.

new_research_deductions.rule: B passes on unseen codebook permutations/symbols/forms plus double-dissociation and causal circuit diagnostics; no specific induction-head implementation is required a priori.
new_research_deductions.reason: Current literature provides multiple mechanistic accounts for ICL/binding.

new_research_deductions.rule: No D open-vs-resolved credit until lexical, length, syntax, branch count and evidence-count nuisance factors are matched/crossed and a lexical-only control remains at chance.
new_research_deductions.reason: The handoff explicitly invalidates the current P2 due to a filler-token shortcut.

new_research_deductions.rule: Independent evidence contribution is keyed to causal/dependence identity, not file/source/worker ancestry count; same payload/dependence group repackaged under a new ancestry remains non-independent.
new_research_deductions.reason: Current-source audit still finds multiplicity leakage in the retained labeler lane; the v2 donor added in this cycle tests this exact failure.
